name: InterContinental Cartagena de Indias
positioning: Contemporary waterfront hotel in Bocagrande, Cartagena's modern district, framed by the Caribbean Sea and Cartagena Bay and minutes from the Walled City
best_for: Travelers who want ocean or bay views and an infinity pool facing the Caribbean sunset
Couples planning a destination wedding in Cartagena

facts.text: The hotel is framed by the Caribbean Sea and Cartagena Bay.
It is in Bocagrande, Cartagena's modern waterfront district, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Walled City.
Accommodations include Classic Rooms, One Bedroom Suites, Ocean Grand Suites and a Presidential Suite.
The Sunset Pool Terrace has an oceanfront infinity pool with a poolside sharing menu served throughout the day.
Kanuu Restaurant's eclectic menu intertwines Caribbean flavor with global sophistication, with a wide variety of drinks and cocktails.
The hotel offers guided yoga sessions, which guests arrange at reception.
The hotel has a spa and a fitness center.
It is a single-use plastic free hotel.
The Rosario and Baru Islands are about 36.8 kilometers from the hotel.
Complimentary parking for hotel guests is in a covered, protected area of the shopping center.

highlights.text: The infinity pool overlooks the Caribbean Sea, with a view of Cartagena's sunset colors.
The hotel offers ocean and bay view accommodations.
A corner of the hotel is dedicated to the Indhy Luna Foundation, with artisanal pieces crafted from natural, eco-friendly fibers that support local communities.
An on-request welcome selection built by chef Juan Jimenez can include local sweets such as enyucado and tamarind, and pan de bono straight from the oven.

considerations.text: The hotel is in modern Bocagrande, not inside the Walled City; Getsemani is about 2.6 kilometers away.
